isecure.bankfiles.accounts_api.AccountCa.description: Current account-capability resolution state; uncertainty is never silently treated as support

isecure.bankfiles.observations.Explanati.description: One safe explanation fact generated from a governed rule and references; it contains no raw values or lineage edges

isecure.bankfiles.operations.ApprovalRef.description: References separately authenticated human approval evidence; presence never replaces authorization

isecure.bankfiles.operations.AttemptRefe.description: Stable reference to an immutable execution or delivery attempt

isecure.bankfiles.operations.Authorizati.description: References the authorization decision evaluated for this exact request

isecure.bankfiles.operations.Cancellatio.description: Whether cancellation can still prevent, may race with, or cannot reverse an effect

isecure.bankfiles.operations.ExactMoney.description: Exact decimal-string amount coupled to its explicit currency

isecure.bankfiles.operations.Idempotency.description: Result of applying a caller idempotency key to the normalized command input; mismatch and expiry never reapply the command
Idempotency evidence returned without echoing the caller key or normalized customer input

isecure.bankfiles.operations.NextOperati.description: A possible next operation; it is guidance and never an authorization grant

isecure.bankfiles.operations.OperationCo.description: Common response context retained across REST, TypeScript, CLI, MCP, and admin adapters

isecure.bankfiles.operations.OperationIs.description: Caller-facing structured issue; safe_message must come from a governed template, and executable content-safety enforcement remains separately gated
Stable category for a caller-facing operation issue; the code remains operation-specific
Presentation severity without changing whether the operation succeeded

isecure.bankfiles.operations.PageRequest.description: Snapshot-stable cursor request shared by list tasks

isecure.bankfiles.operations.PageResult.description: Snapshot-stable cursor result shared by list tasks

isecure.bankfiles.operations.PlatformIss.description: Common fail-closed runtime issue envelope; operation-specific issue contracts remain available for domain rejections

isecure.bankfiles.operations.RequiredAct.description: Typed user action required to continue; no variant contains credentials or approval tokens

isecure.bankfiles.operations.ResourceRef.description: Stable reference to one governed customer-facing resource revision

isecure.bankfiles.operations.TaskReferen.description: Reference returned for work that outlives a synchronous request

isecure.bankfiles.operations.TaskState.description: Durable task state; indeterminate is distinct from failure

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.AppendPay.description: Append a bounded set of new transfers without resending existing transfers

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.Configure.description: Customer selects one stable business profile from the authenticated server catalogue and supplies debtor identity; no bank connection, credential, renderer, namespace or storage route is accepted

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.GenerateP.description: Generate a file from exactly these current order and export-profile revisions; no approval or bank submission is requested

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentAp.description: Customer approval state over exact immutable revision digests; it is not bank authorization or SCA
Compact human decision result without approval tokens or payment values

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentAu.description: External bank or channel authorization state; it never substitutes for customer approval

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentBa.description: Aggregate bank outcome that never flattens partial, contradictory, or unknown transfer outcomes

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentBu.description: Qualified customer-facing payment business family; unsupported families are separate aggregates

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentCa.description: Business criteria for explicit capability resolution; the resolver never silently selects an ambiguous candidate
Non-secret reference to one immutable account-bound capability; authority is rechecked on every use
Explicit capability result with zero, one, or several candidates and no default substitution
Immutable payment capability over the existing connected-account capability identity

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentCu.description: Exact total for one currency; different currencies are never combined and no implicit rounding is permitted

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentEx.description: Tenant-visible admission state in the current Processing release
One exact bank and country export profile admitted by the current tenant Processing release; renderer identity and validator locators remain private
Exact governed outbound qualification state; availability in one Processing release is separate
Customer-visible metadata for one exact prepared pain.001 artifact; private object-store coordinates are never present

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentGr.description: Finalization-time feasibility result; authoritative must always be false
Non-authoritative grouping hint over an exact finalized revision; it is not a PaymentBatch, execution plan, rendered artifact, or provider promise

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentOr.description: Minimal business draft with one explicitly selected source-account capability; an open draft may start empty
Atomic finalization result; preview is advisory and creates no canonical PaymentBatch
Compact mutation result deliberately excluding creditor accounts, remittance, customer references, and money
Customer aggregate projection over one selected immutable revision; current_revision_id keeps the current head distinct while orthogonal lifecycle axes remain current and visible
Immutable exact order revision; its digest is the customer-approval binding
Exact immutable revision selector for validation and simulation replay
Compact list projection without creditor, account, remittance, customer-reference, or money fields
Stable customer workflow state; validation, approval, execution, authorization, and bank outcomes remain separate

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentRe.description: Typed recovery guidance that grants no authority

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.PaymentTr.description: One ordered customer transfer; internal IDs, ordinals, ISO fields, counts, and control sums are derived

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.RemovePay.description: Remove a bounded set of exact stable transfer identities in a new immutable order revision

isecure.bankfiles.payments_api.RevisePay.description: Order-level revision body; its transfer sequence must be unchanged so stable identities cannot be guessed by position, while append, exact-transfer revise and remove own transfer changes; optimistic concurrency is generated transport metadata
Replace the content of one stable transfer identity in a new immutable order revision
